description: Returns the central bank's policy rate for a country (Bank for International Settlements, about 40 central banks, the ECB for euro countries), the date it last changed, and the country's latest yearly inflation. For the US, returns Treasury yields from the Treasury's daily par yield curve (1 month to 30 years), each next to the latest 12-month inflation (BLS CPI) as a yield minus trailing CPI, and optionally the interest an amount would earn at one term. Applies to questions about current central-bank policy rates, or US Treasury yields next to inflation. Not investment advice. The change in purchasing power of money from a past year is outside this result.

amount.description: Dollar amount to show interest for

country.description: Country name or two-letter code; defaults to the United States

term.description: Term for the interest example; default 1 year

name: check_rates
title: Rates: interest rates now, after inflation
